references.text: God gives plants as food for both humans and animals, a theme repeated in Deuteronomy 11:15
God causes grass to grow for cattle and plants for human use, paralleling the promise of grass on the field for livestock
God gives food to all living creatures at the right time and satisfies everything that lives
God causes grass to grow on the mountains and provides food for cattle
The promise of eating and being satisfied as a sign of God's blessing over the people
The promise of eating bread until full as part of the covenant blessings
The promise of eating, being satisfied, and praising the Lord in the good land
Jesus teaches about God's care for the birds, pointing to God's provision for all creation
